# Allen Code Co.

> Solo build-to-sell software studio run by Chris Allen. Custom SaaS builds, MVP sprints, AI integration, technical audits, and acquisition-readiness consulting — plus four in-house SaaS products and a library of Next.js/Tailwind starter templates.

## Products
- [My Teachers Toolbox](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/my-teachers-toolbox): AI tools for K-5 teachers, built in real classrooms. Live at myteacherstoolbox.com.
- [UnderFire AI](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/underfire-ai): Interview and salary negotiation coaching, on demand. Live at underfireai.com.
- [Founders Helm](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/founders-helm): A solo founder operating system — ten integrated business tools in one workspace. Live at foundershelm.com.
- [Crew Advisors](https://www.allencodeco.com/products/crew-advisors): Your AI advisory board — expert personas with persistent memory of your business. Coming soon.

## Services
- [Custom SaaS Builds](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Full custom application, built and shipped by one senior developer. Starting at $18,000, 6–12 weeks.
- [MVP Sprints](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Scope-locked 4–6 week build to get a real product in front of real users. Starting at $9,500, 4–6 weeks.
- [AI Integration & OpenRouter Routing](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Model routing, cost controls, and fallbacks. Starting at $4,500, 1–3 weeks.
- [Technical Audits](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Senior-level codebase and architecture review with acquisition-readiness scoring. Flat fee $2,000, 3–5 business days.
- [Acquisition-Readiness Consulting](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Get docs, codebase, and metrics ready for buyer diligence. Starting at $6,000, 2–4 weeks.
- [Custom Web Development](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): Custom-built websites, static HTML/CSS or React/Vite. Starting at $2,500, 1–3 weeks.
- [UI/UX Design](https://www.allencodeco.com/services): User flow mapping, high-fidelity mockups, and handoff-ready specs. Starting at $2,500, 1–2 weeks.

## Templates
- [Templates store](https://www.allencodeco.com/templates): SaaS landing pages, dev portfolios, dashboard starters, and agency sites, built with Next.js and Tailwind. $59–$149 each.
